purpose: Single human-readable catalogue of Breeze market rules and their independent use in Breeze scoring and TorchSharp threshold correction.
invariants: number is permanent and never reused
id is the stable code key
detector is shared; Breeze and TorchSharp applications are independent
Breeze frozen weights must not be changed by TorchSharp experiments
TorchSharp calibration is stored independently for ZZ1, ZZ2 and ZZ3 and for trading modes 0 and 1
Boss is a derived composition of ZZ1, ZZ2 and ZZ3 and never owns an independent calibration cell
weight_threshold_pp changes the TorchSharp ensemble threshold in percentage points
Help documents this file but is not executable source code

torchsharp_threshold_model.formula: threshold_t = clip(baseline_percent + sum(weight_threshold_pp_i * active_value_i_t), min_percent, max_percent)

sign.negative: lower threshold: easier entry and longer holding
sign.positive: raise threshold: harder entry and earlier exit

torchsharp_threshold_model.timing: Use only values known after the close of bar t; orders are formed for the next executable bar.

excluded_package.name: Boss
excluded_package.reason: Boss is composed from the independently calibrated ZZ1, ZZ2 and ZZ3 cells.

trading_modes.0: package ensemble trades as one 10-position block

torchsharp_research_matrix.storage: Each tested rule may add torchsharp.calibration_by_context keyed by ZZ1/ZZ2/ZZ3 and mode_0/mode_1. Missing cells mean not tested. Results at different base thresholds are separate observations and must not overwrite one another.

field_guide.id: Stable program key such as R03 or Z02.
field_guide.detector: One shared causal calculation of the event/state.
field_guide.torchsharp: Independent threshold correction and its own lifecycle.
field_guide.activation: How an observed event remains active for TorchSharp.
field_guide.calibration_by_context: Sparse per-rule results for ZZ1/ZZ2/ZZ3 and trading modes 0/1; Boss is derived and is never stored here.
